# 佛說超日明三昧經

**ID:** T0638
**Volume:** T15
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 西晉 聶承遠譯
**Dynasty:** 西晉
**Date:** 290–306
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0638

## Contributors
- 聶承遠 (A001882)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T638 (two fascicles, alt. title 超日明經) is a Mahāyāna *samādhi*-sūtra translated in the Western Jin by the lay scholar [聶承遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%B6%E6%89%BF%E9%81%A0) (Niè Chéngyuǎn, fl. c. 290–308) on the basis of an earlier translation by [Dharmarakṣa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7). The *chāorìmíng sānmèi* — the samādhi "surpassing the brilliance of the sun" — is described as a meditative concentration in which the bodhisattva's wisdom outshines all other lights, including the cosmic luminaries.

**Abstract**

[聶承遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%B6%E6%89%BF%E9%81%A0) (Niè Chéngyuǎn) was the close lay collaborator of Dharmarakṣa at the Cháng'ān–Luòyáng translation workshop in the late Western Jin; the *[Chū sānzàng jì jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0084)* (T2145, juan 13) gives his biography. He worked together with his son [聶道真](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%B6%E9%81%93%E7%9C%9F) Niè Dàozhēn as Dharmarakṣa's principal Chinese assistants and is independently credited with redacting and re-editing earlier Dharmarakṣa drafts into more polished Chinese. The *[Lìdài sānbǎo jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0011)* explicitly notes that T638 was originally drafted by Dharmarakṣa and revised by Niè Chéngyuǎn into its present form; modern scholarship (Boucher 2008) treats it as a joint work. Date bracket follows Niè Chéngyuǎn's attested productive period (c. 290–308). The text develops the bodhisattva-path through the figure of light surpassing the sun and is one of the early Chinese sources for the Mahāyāna doctrine of the bodhisattva's supernal radiance.
